title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B
summary: Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B on one DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB) served natively by gr8 (g6embed + g6front-rs): calibrated exlr8-v2 4-bit trellis (4.66 GB on disk, 6.73 GiB GPU peak, 2.07 s warm boot), 31.8 ms query p50 / 3,545 tok/s at 8 concurrent streams, -0.0010 mean 15-task delta vs BF16 (0.9942 text / 0.9832 image held-out cosine), full DeepStack vision + Matryoshka (64..4096) on /v1/embeddings.

configs.notes: Measured 2026-11-27 on one NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB, ARM64 64 KiB page kernel, 2200 MHz SM clock cap) with gr8 g6embed + g6front-rs (full 65-file XXH64 checksum verification, CAP=16384, MAX_MODEL_LEN=16384, native mode: 310 Trellis K4 + 4 int4_g32 + 55 FP8_ROW + 1 BF16 pos_embed). Concurrency rows measure live HTTP /v1/embeddings throughput (tokens/s and median request latency) at 1, 8, and 16 concurrent clients (single-request array batching reaches 3,484 tok/s at batch 8, 3,452 tok/s at batch 16, and 48.4 items/s / 3,102 tok/s at batch 64). 32-item multimodal suite p50: 46.72 ms overall (31.77 ms instructed query, 29.80 ms raw text, 244.48 ms image-only, 235.07 ms image+text).
